inputs.text: I just saw this breakdown claiming to examine the conflict between the United States, Israel, and Iran, zeroing in on escalating violence, ethical implications, and the chance of wider regional conflict. But it's obvious this is coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions, twisting the narrative around targeting civilian areas and threats to infrastructure to serve their agenda. They're trotting out historical context and philosophical arguments on just war as a deliberate smokescreen, inverting the truth so we swallow their version while they escalate things behind the scenes for their own concealed interests.
